$description: Dark palette. bg.page is deep green (deepGreenPage), text.heading uses sageLight. brand.link, brand.eyebrow, and focus.ring all point to plumLight now — light mode moved all three off magenta/rust onto plum, so dark follows with plum's lightened tint, consistent with this theme's rule that a dark tint is always its light counterpart's hue. brand.primary/primaryStrong/accent and solid status.<name> fills remain un-overridden: white text on top holds contrast regardless of theme.

page.$description: Palette D: deep green direction for dark mode, no pink. Was {color.charcoal}.

heading.$description: Palette D: reuses the existing inverse-surface muted text color for dark headings. Was {color.plumLight}.

link.$description: Follows light mode's move to plum. 11.28:1 vs bg.page.

eyebrow.$description: Follows light mode's move off magenta (reserved for Accent secundario) onto plum. 11.28:1 vs bg.page.

ring.$description: Follows light mode's move to plum, for the same reason: keeps the ring's hue independent of brand.primary's. 11.28:1 vs bg.page, 9.95:1 vs bg.surface.
